rules.title: Prohibited inquiries of persons seeking to rent (Section 4, subsection 7(c))
rules.requirement: It is an unlawful practice for owners, lessees, brokers, managing agents, other persons with the right to rent or lease covered housing accommodations, or their agents or employees, to make or cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record about the race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran status or military membership, blindness, hearing impairment or other handicap, or possession of a trained dog guide, of a person seeking to rent or lease the accommodation.
rules.coverage_text: Owners, lessees, sublessees, real estate brokers, assignees or managing agents of other covered housing accommodations or land, other persons with the right to rent, lease or sell them, their agents or employees, and organizations of unit owners in a condominium or housing cooperative.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply to the leasing of a single apartment or flat in a two family dwelling where the other unit is occupied by the owner as his residence. The word 'age' does not apply to minors, to residency in state-aided or federally-aided housing developments for the elderly, to residency in federal low income housing tax credit developments intended for persons 55 or over or 62 or over, or to communities built expressly for persons 55 or over or 62 or over if the owner or manager registers biennially with the executive office of housing and livable communities.
rules.quoted_span: (c) to cause to be made any written or oral inquiry or record concerning the race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, which shall not include persons whose sexual orientation involves minor children as the sex object, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, veteran status or membership in the armed services, blindness, hearing impairment or other handicap or because such person possesses a trained dog guide as a consequence of blindness or hearing impairment, of the person seeking to rent or lease or buy any such accommodation or land; provided, however, that this subsection shall not apply to the leasing of a single apartment or flat in a two family dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied by the owner as his residence.
rules.interaction_text: For the purpose of this subsection, housing intended for occupancy by persons fifty-five or over and sixty-two or over shall comply with the provisions set forth in 42 USC 3601 et seq.

rules.title: Public assistance and housing subsidy discrimination (Section 4, subsection 10)
rules.requirement: It is an unlawful practice for any person furnishing rental accommodations to discriminate against an individual because the individual receives federal, state, or local public assistance or housing subsidies, including rental assistance, or because of any requirement of such a program.
rules.coverage_text: Any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations.
rules.quoted_span: 10. For any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance, or who is a tenant receiving federal, state, or local housing subsidies, including rental assistance or rental supplements, because the individual is such a recipient, or because of any requirement of such public assistance, rental assistance, or housing subsidy program.
